## 1. Goal
Prove in a real browser that every control on every page does what it says, for any input, and that the C engine, the WebAssembly layer and the website agree.

## 2. Background
Krishna reported that some things do not work on the Run page. PRD sections 7, 8, 10, 10A and BLUEPRINT section 5 define the expected behaviour.

## 3. Scope
**In scope:** clean build check; click matrix `docs/design/K-50_CLICK_MATRIX.md`; a browser pass over every control, scheduler, preset, CSV case, URL hash case, theme, 375 and 1440 px, keyboard; console versus website comparison; one fix PR per root cause, each with a failing test first.

**Out of scope:** PRD section 5 changes (PR #95 needs Krishna).

## 4. Files
| Path | Create / modify | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| docs/design/K-50_CLICK_MATRIX.md | create | One row per interaction |
| tests/demo/, tests/web/, tests/py/ | create / modify | Browser pass, regression tests, conformance |

## 5. Specification
Every row: page, control, input, expected result, source, actual result, status. The UI never computes or rounds away a scheduling result; every scheduler offered exists in the engine.

## 6. Step-by-step tasks
1. Reproduce from latest main. 2. Write the matrix. 3. Click all of it. 4. Compare console and website. 5. Fix, smallest first. 6. Prove it.

## 7. Tests to write
| Test name | What it checks | Expected result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| click matrix pass | every row in a real browser | Pass or stated deferral |
| conformance | every policy and preset, row by row | Identical |
| regressions | one per root cause | Fail before, pass after |

## 8. Acceptance criteria (Done when)
- [ ] Every matrix row passes or is a stated, explained deferral
- [ ] make test, make sanitize, make web-test, make hardening, pytest tests/py
- [ ] check_layout_cdp and rehearse_cdp --offline on the built site
- [ ] PRD 10A demo path offline with no console errors
- [ ] Fresh clone builds and opens following the README alone
- [ ] CI green

## 9. How to verify
`make wasm && make web`, then the commands in section 8.

## 10. Viva notes
The evidence that the live demo will work. Examiner question: "How do you know the website matches the C program?" Every policy and preset compared row by row.

## 11. Pitfalls
- Hiding a broken control instead of fixing it
- Trusting unit tests with a fake engine

Read CLAUDE.md, then this issue in full.
